question: Which of the following tennis stars announced her retirement from tennis on 26 February 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maria Sharapova.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In **February 2020**, **Maria Sharapova** declared her **retirement** from tennis.
 
• Maria Sharapova is a **Russian professional tennis player.**
 
• She competed on the **WTA Tour from 2001 to 2020 and was ranked world No 1.**
 
• After retiring in 2020, she's carried on with work on her** brand Sugarpova, along with working on her charity the Maria Sharapova Foundation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Justine Henin** is a Belgian former professional tennis player.
 
• **Venus Ebony Starr Williams** is an American professional tennis player.
 
• **Kim Clijsters** is a Belgian former professional tennis player.​
